problems: Fix run 2026-10-24: all four failed dossiers (italian-africa, republic-of-sudan, sudan-people-s-liberation-movement, rapid-support-forces) were repaired from pages re-opened with WebFetch and validate (0 errors; warnings only for open-ended contests and for the new counterpart slugs senussi-order, tripolitanian-republic, anglo-egyptian-sudan). The five other dossiers were not touched. 19 of the 19 findings are applied; the notes file's last section lists where I read a finding differently (1989 SPLA extent at confidence 1 not 2, five enclaves not seven, the Majeerteen vassal_end moved to October 1925, Axis swings recorded as Italian at confidence 2).

Convention used: new keyframes override the Cliopatria shape inside its span, as republic-of-sudan_2011 already did (italian-africa_1924, _1925, _1928, _1931; republic-of-sudan_1989, _1997, _2000, _2005, _2023). The Cliopatria entries italian-africa_1922, _1926, _1930 and republic-of-sudan_1963, _1992, _2014 are effective only for the first years of their spans (stated in each note). The renderer must let a keyframe with from/to win over a Cliopatria shape for those years.

Mirrors needed in other groups: ethiopian-empire (af-01): Tigray gain 1895-4 and loss 1896-3, 1936-5 dissolve counterpart italian-africa; british-africa (af-08-b): Kassala and Moyale 1940-1941, Cyrenaica swings 1940-1943, Tripolitania February 1943, Union 1910 against its December 1931 loss, Jubaland 1925, Sarra 1934, Emirate of Cyrenaica 1949; kingdom-of-egypt (me-10): Italian occupation of the Sollum-Sidi Barrani strip September-December 1940 and the Jarabub cession of 6 December 1925; mahdist-state (af-01): Kassala 17 July 1894 month; south-sudan (af-08): the SPLM no longer dissolves into South Sudan, Abyei contest stays open; sultanate-of-hobyo and majeerteen-sultanate: dates now agree, but the 1889 protectorates are still renames there, not vassal events.

Page budgets were exceeded on purpose because the findings named pages the first run had not opened: italian-africa 15 pages (budget 9), republic-of-sudan 8 (5), sudan-people-s-liberation-movement 3, rapid-support-forces 2. Pages that did not give what a finding assumed: the Italian Somaliland page has no Di Bello or October 1925 entry (the Campaign of the Sultanates page does); the First Italo-Ethiopian War page does not give 26 October 1896; the Kassala and East African campaign pages do not give the day Kassala fell; the British Somaliland page has no Berbera landing date and contradicts itself on March against 8 April 1941; the French military administration in Fezzan page gives January 1943 without a day; the Torit page does not mention the civil war. The rebuild in scratch (italian-africa.mine-2026-10-24.json) was only a template.
The two failed URLs of the first run (Sudan-South Sudan border conflict, both spellings) were not retried; the Heglig Crisis page still stands in for them in republic-of-sudan.
